description.value:
Prerequisites: Red Mage 6

As a swift action, a red mage can spend 1 point from his arcane pool and gain the effects of a water walk spell for 10 minutes per red mage level. If he expends 2 points from his arcane pool, he can affect a total number of touched creatures equal to his red mage level.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Arcana)
